question: how much I can spend on my lunch when traveling?
must_include: No separate lunch limit; domestic meals up to $60 per day in total; only for overnight travel (not day trips). May also mention international AUD $100 per day or ask domestic vs international
must_not_include: $50 (old FY2026 limit); an invented lunch-only limit

question: Can I get paid back for driving my own car to a client site in Geelong?
must_include: Yes; private vehicle reimbursed at $0.85 per kilometre
must_not_include: $0.80 (old FY2026 rate)

question: What's the per diem for a day trip to Canberra?
must_include: Meals are not claimable for day trips with no overnight stay
must_not_include: Any daily meal amount presented as claimable for a day trip

question: how much I can spend on the accommodation when I travel aboard and who I should apply for the over budget cost?
must_include: AUD $350 per night; amounts above the limit approved by the Head of Finance whatever the amount
must_not_include: Giving a Delegation of Authority tier (Line Manager / Department Head / CFO) as the approver (mentioning the tiers only to say they do not apply is fine)
source: International Travel Policy s3 and s6

question: What should I do if there is no accommodation under $350 per night in the city I'm travelling to?
must_include: Expenses above the limit need Head of Finance approval whatever the amount
must_not_include: Giving a Delegation of Authority tier as the approver; saying the user can book above the limit without approval
source: International Travel Policy s3 and s6

question: My hotel in Brisbane came to $1000 over the policy limit in total. Who needs to approve the extra?
must_include: Department Head (amount above limit $500.01 to $2000); refers to both the Domestic Travel Policy and the Delegation of Authority
must_not_include: Giving Head of Finance / Line Manager / CFO as the approver for this domestic case (a conditional note about trips with an international leg is fine)
source: Domestic Travel Policy FY2027 s7 + Delegation of Authority s2

question: My hotel in Singapore came to $1000 over the policy limit in total. Who needs to approve the extra?
must_include: Head of Finance (international policy replaces the Delegation of Authority)
must_not_include: Giving Department Head or any Delegation of Authority tier as the approver (mentioning it only to say it does not apply is fine)

question: Who do I need to get approval from before booking a domestic flight versus an international flight?
must_include: Domestic: line manager; International: Department Head
must_not_include: Swapping the two approvers
source: Domestic Travel Policy FY2027 s2 + International Travel Policy s2

question: How much I can spend on the accommodation in the capital city?
must_include: $250 per night (FY2027)
must_not_include: $220 (old FY2026 limit)

question: How long do I have to submit my expense claim after a domestic trip?
must_include: Within 30 days of the end of the trip
must_not_include: 60 days (old FY2026 rule)

question: What's the hotel limit for a regional town like Ballarat?
must_include: $180 per night
must_not_include: $160 (old FY2026 limit); $250

question: I'm staying overnight at a remote mine site in WA for work. What's my daily meal limit?
must_include: Conditional: $80 per day if the location is listed as remote in the TravelHub location list; otherwise $60
must_not_include: Stating $80 without the TravelHub condition; only $60 (missed exception); $70 (old remote rate)
source: Domestic Travel Policy FY2027 s4 + Appendix A1

question: I'm flying Melbourne to Sydney, then Sydney to Singapore. What's the hotel limit for my night in Sydney?
must_include: International Travel Policy applies to the whole trip including domestic legs; AUD $350 per night
must_not_include: $250 (domestic capital city limit)
source: Domestic Travel Policy FY2027 Appendix A2 + International Travel Policy s3

question: Can I fly business class to London?
must_include: Business class allowed for a single flight longer than 8 hours; otherwise economy
must_not_include: Economy only with no exception; business class with no condition

question: What's my total budget for meals and accommodation on a 3-day trip to Sydney?
